name: Cat
description: An animated cat in the bar that walks and gallops with CPU load, and grooms, stretches and naps while the machine idles.

settings.label: Cat size (px)
settings.description: The cat's square in the bar. The bar's height caps it.

settings.label: Show CPU percentage
settings.description: Show the load beside the cat.

settings.label: Colour
settings.description: The theme colour the cat paints in.

settings.label: Idle below (% CPU)
settings.description: Under this load the cat stops moving: it sits, grooms, scratches, stretches, and in time naps. 0 keeps it on the move.

settings.label: Nap after (s)
settings.description: How long the cat idles before it falls asleep. 0 sends it straight to sleep.

settings.label: Top speed at (% CPU)
settings.description: The load at which the cat runs flat out.

settings.label: Warn above (% CPU)
settings.description: Paints the cat in the error colour at or above this load. 0 turns the warning off.

settings.label: Sample every (s)
settings.description: How often CPU load is read from /proc/stat.
